title: Windproof and Ready  (À Prova de Vento e Pronto)

segments.t: Chega o final da manhã de sábado, ensolarada e embalada pela brisa, na Pousada do Pátio da Tília, em Portland. Faltando cinco para o meio-dia, Hannah, Tessa e Caleb estão debaixo da grande tília admirando as vinte e quatro lanternas corais e douradas que balançam tranquilamente da varanda superior até os galhos. Ouçam primeiro toda a cena.
Look up at those four lines from the balcony — not one lantern twisted overnight!
And look down at the tables: twenty-eight linen napkins clipped tight with numbered birch pins!
Even Graham clipped four extra clothespins to the corners of every white tablecloth!
At three this afternoon I bake four berry almond cakes so they are warm by six.
And at four this afternoon Evelyn and I finish rehearsing our four hand piano duet!
Everything is timed to the minute: afternoon prep, five thirty tea, six sharp arrival!
Knock on wood right now, Hannah — never say everything is timed to the minute!
What could possibly change at noon? Our guest wrote six this evening in black ink!
Wait — do you two hear the front desk telephone ringing through the lobby window?
That is a very loud, very urgent Saturday noon ring, Hannah!
Even Graham just looked up from his paper ledger behind the glass door!
Hold my apron — I had better answer that call before twelve chimes finish!
Vamos seguir agora fala por fala esta cena final do quarto episódio.
Look up at those four lines from the balcony — not one lantern twisted overnight!
'Olhem lá em cima naqueles quatro fios da varanda — nem uma lanterna sequer torceu durante a noite!'
And look down at the tables: twenty-eight linen napkins clipped tight with numbered birch pins!
'E olhem para baixo nas mesas: vinte e oito guardanapos de linho presos firmes com prendedores de bétula numerados!'
Even Graham clipped four extra clothespins to the corners of every white tablecloth!
'O Graham até prendeu quatro prendedores extras nos cantos de cada toalha de mesa branca!'
At three this afternoon I bake four berry almond cakes so they are warm by six.
'Às três da tarde de hoje eu asso quatro tortas de amora e amêndoa para estarem quentinhas até as seis.'
And at four this afternoon Evelyn and I finish rehearsing our four hand piano duet!
'E às quatro da tarde de hoje Evelyn e eu terminamos de ensaiar nosso dueto de piano a quatro mãos!'
Everything is timed to the minute: afternoon prep, five thirty tea, six sharp arrival!
'Tudo está cronometrado no minuto exato: preparativos de tarde, chá das cinco e meia, chegada às seis em ponto!'
Knock on wood right now, Hannah — never say everything is timed to the minute!
'Bata na madeira agora, Hannah — nunca diga que está tudo cronometrado no minuto exato!'
What could possibly change at noon? Our guest wrote six this evening in black ink!
'O que poderia mudar ao meio-dia, afinal? Nosso convidado escreveu seis desta noite com tinta preta!'
Wait — do you two hear the front desk telephone ringing through the lobby window?
'Esperem aí — vocês dois também estão ouvindo o telefone da recepção tocando lá da janela do saguão?'
That is a very loud, very urgent Saturday noon ring, Hannah!
'Isso sim é um toque de sábado ao meio-dia bem alto e bem urgente, Hannah!'
Even Graham just looked up from his paper ledger behind the glass door!
'Até o Graham acabou de levantar os olhos do seu livro de registro atrás do vidro!'
Hold my apron — I had better answer that call before twelve chimes finish!
'Segurem meu avental — é melhor eu atender aquela ligação antes de acabarem as doze badaladas!'
Vamos ouvir de novo a cena inteira presa na linha do telefone.
Look up at those four lines from the balcony — not one lantern twisted overnight!
And look down at the tables: twenty-eight linen napkins clipped tight with numbered birch pins!
Even Graham clipped four extra clothespins to the corners of every white tablecloth!
At three this afternoon I bake four berry almond cakes so they are warm by six.
And at four this afternoon Evelyn and I finish rehearsing our four hand piano duet!
Everything is timed to the minute: afternoon prep, five thirty tea, six sharp arrival!
Knock on wood right now, Hannah — never say everything is timed to the minute!
What could possibly change at noon? Our guest wrote six this evening in black ink!
Wait — do you two hear the front desk telephone ringing through the lobby window?
That is a very loud, very urgent Saturday noon ring, Hannah!
Even Graham just looked up from his paper ledger behind the glass door!
Hold my apron — I had better answer that call before twelve chimes finish!

Cada lanterna e prendedor de madeira está pronto para as seis — até que um telefonema ao meio-dia em ponto vira de pernas para o ar todo o cronograma de sábado! Fim do quarto episódio: esperamos vocês no quinto, até lá!
See you next time!
